summary: Bound the per-subject history cost of internal status reductions: agent cards, session lists and runtime/host projections read a canonical claims summary instead of every claim id.

replay.detail: No claim replay change. The summary is a read-side reduction over the same accepted-time index and canonical claim keys.

schema.detail: No database schema or index change.

rules.detail: No checkpoint, retention or fleet coordination change.

compatibility.detail: No client, protocol or harness contract change. /v1/status and terminal listings still serialize the full canonical claims vector; summaries are proven equal to the vector's latest id, count and session window boundary at every cut.

manual.detail: No manual action is required after upgrading.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
